meta.note: 计算器在组合这些选项时触发对应提示/禁止。匹配语义：when 数组全部满足 + any 数组（可选）至少一个命中；when 项可以是选项 id，也可以是上下文键（windows / sm_120 / pagefile_used 等）。severity: forbid=禁止组合, warn=高风险, info=注意事项

rules.message: PDD 官方蒸馏：不要与其他蒸馏 LoRA 叠加，也不要使用步数缓存节点；采样必须走 PDD 节点输出的 sigmas（euler、CFG=1.0）
rules.message_en: Official PDD distillation: do not stack with other distill LoRAs or use step-cache nodes; sampling must use the sigmas output by the PDD node (euler, CFG=1.0)

rules.message: MiniMax H3 fp8_scaled + --use-sage-attention + DynamicVRAM 同开，首个去噪步会原生崩溃。去掉其中任一即可
rules.message_en: MiniMax H3 fp8_scaled + --use-sage-attention + DynamicVRAM together crash natively on the first denoise step. Removing any one of them fixes it

rules.message: sm_120 (50 系) 上序列超过约 16 万 token（约 1920×1088 超过 10 秒，或 1344×768 超过 26 秒）时，核心 Sage 路径会静默输出噪点。长片段建议改用 KJNodes Patch Sage / comfy-kitchen 后端，或 SLA / VSA 稀疏注意力（见第 2 步注意力选项）
rules.message_en: On sm_120 (50-series), sequences beyond ~160k tokens (about 1920×1088 over 10 s, or 1344×768 over 26 s) make the core Sage path output silent noise. For long clips switch to the KJNodes Patch Sage / comfy-kitchen backend, or SLA / VSA sparse attention (see the attention options in step 2)

rules.message: 使用 Turbo 采样节点时，切回原生 LoRA 节点前必须重启 ComfyUI，否则旧显存不释放，容易爆显存
rules.message_en: When using Turbo sampling nodes, ComfyUI must be restarted before switching back to the native LoRA node; otherwise the old VRAM is not freed and OOM is likely

rules.message: diffusers 格式的 H3 LoRA 直接放进 ComfyUI 会静默不生效或错位，必须用已验证的转换版（如 matsuo-koya 的 h3_lora_convert.py / drbaph 转换仓库）
rules.message_en: Dropping a diffusers-format H3 LoRA straight into ComfyUI silently does nothing or misaligns; use a verified conversion (e.g. matsuo-koya's h3_lora_convert.py / the drbaph conversion repo)

rules.message: Windows 下 >20GB 的 safetensors 用 mmap 读取会崩，建议在启动参数勾选 --disable-mmap
rules.message_en: On Windows, mmap-reading safetensors >20GB crashes; enable --disable-mmap in the launch arguments

rules.message: NVFP4 扩散模型权重需要 Blackwell (RTX 50 / PRO 6000)；NVFP4 文本编码器走反量化路径则不受限
rules.message_en: NVFP4 diffusion-model weights require Blackwell (RTX 50 / PRO 6000); the NVFP4 text encoder goes through a dequant path and is not restricted

rules.message: 已有组合开始落页文件：每步重新读取 20GB 级权重会把单步时间推到 10 秒级并产生 SSD 写入。32GB 内存机型建议 64GB 或严格 --fast-disk
rules.message_en: The current combination is hitting the pagefile: re-reading 20GB-class weights every step pushes per-step time to ~10 s and causes SSD writes. On 32GB RAM machines, go to 64GB or use --fast-disk strictly
rules.source: shiqikuangsan31 指南 / Tomiigo 16GB 实测

rules.message: GGUF 与部分内存优化节点（如 Zironic H3MemoryOptimization）不兼容；GGUF 下 Sage 收益不稳定
rules.message_en: GGUF is incompatible with some memory-optimization nodes (e.g. Zironic H3MemoryOptimization); Sage gains are unstable under GGUF

rules.message: SLA 稀疏必须成套使用：SLA 训练版 Turbo LoRA（lightx2v SLA）+ H3 SLA Attention 节点（PlagueKind）；在非 SLA 权重上开稀疏路由会明显掉画质。语音片段音频块保持 64（128 会让对白发闷）
rules.message_en: SLA sparsity must be used as a set: SLA-trained Turbo LoRA (lightx2v SLA) + H3 SLA Attention node (PlagueKind); enabling sparse routing on non-SLA weights visibly degrades quality. Keep the audio block at 64 for speech clips (128 muffles dialogue)

rules.message: VSA 需要 FastVideo VSA 节点（barelymining/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-FastVideo）或最新 ComfyUI 核心 Block Sparse Attention 节点（comfy-kitchen ≥0.2.33）；与 FastH3 4 步蒸馏 LoRA 配合收益最大，短片提升有限
rules.message_en: VSA requires the FastVideo VSA node (barelymining/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-FastVideo) or the latest ComfyUI core Block Sparse Attention node (comfy-kitchen ≥0.2.33); it pays off most with the FastH3 4-step distill LoRA, with limited benefit on short clips
